title: Experimental detection of inclusions for the time-harmonic elastic wave equation
summary: We are concerned with the reconstruction of inclusions in elastic bodies based on measurements from a laboratory experiment. In doing so, we solve the inverse problem of the time-harmonic elastic wave equation, in contrast to the stationary wave equation and the corresponding lab experiment proposed earlier in Eberle and Moll (2021). The investigation of the harmonic problem leads to a better reconstruction compared to the stationary one.
